title: Simple Modern Kids Water Bottle with Straw Lid | 14oz Insulated Stainless Steel Kids Tumbler & Spill Proof Toddler Cup for School, Girls, Boys | Summit | Confetti

reviews.title: Cute water bottle for little kids.
reviews.body: The cutest starter water bottle for my child. My daughter has two of these now and she’s the only one. There are small and easy for her to handle but still hold a lot of water. They have the full lead so they don’t spill and they’re easy to clean. good quality at a reasonable price and they have the cutest colors/patterns.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 8, 2026
reviews.author: MRobertson

reviews.title: Best Kids Water Bottle
reviews.body: This is the best children’s water bottle. I have bought so many of these because the patterns are so cute plus the functionality is on point. You can ditch the straws inside and the kids can tilt it back just like you would a normal water bottle to drink out of and it’s much easier to clean in my opinion. The Bows were especially so cute for a dance recital gift for my Daughter. I did bedazzle the bows myself so note that is not included. Drinks stay cold for a longer period of time as it is double walled insulated. The size is perfect for a child to carry around. Lid is easy for little fingers to open. This was one of the only bottles that wasn't going to spill in her backpack by accidentally getting pressed to open. Now she can stay hydrated all day after running around on playground at school on hot afternoons.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 13, 2026
reviews.author: Heather

reviews.title: Excellent water bottle!
reviews.body: Excellent water bottle that has held up to many trips and being dropped. Keeps water cold and the design has not wore off after 6+ months of daily use. Very satisfied with this purchase.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 25, 2026
reviews.author: efant437

reviews.title: So cute!
reviews.body: We have finally found the ultimate water bottle for our son, and it's the Simple Modern kids' version with the dinosaur print! It is absolutely perfect for daycare, school, and trips to the park.The main reason I love it is the design. The dinos are super cute and vibrant, which actually makes my son excited to drink his water. The flip-top straw lid is brilliant—it’s easy for his little hands to open and, more importantly, it is genuinely spill-proof when closed. We’ve had zero leaks in the backpack so far.It’s durable, too. It’s been dropped on pavement countless times and just keeps going. The stainless steel keeps his drink cold all day. It’s simple to clean and fits perfectly in his lunchbox and the car seat cup holder. A parent and kid win! We will definitely be buying more designs as he grows.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on January 28, 2026
reviews.author: Tsveta Ivanova

reviews.title: Keeps water cold
reviews.body: This is a good value for the money. We have manny different brands of water bottles, and this one keeps water cold the longest. The size is perfect. It fits in a car seat cup holder well. It’s easy to carry in a backpack for school or for hiking. The handle allows children to get a good grip on it. The patterns are cute. We have both the planets and the ballerinas. Although they do start to fade with repeated dishwasher use.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on April 27, 2026
reviews.author: Grace C

features: SPILL PROOF & LEAKPROOF STRAW LID: Our kids water bottle stays leakproof when the nozzle is in the closed position - toss it in a backpack or lunch bag without worrying about soaked schoolbooks. Not for hot or carbonated beverages

DOUBLE WALL INSULATED: Vacuum insulated stainless steel keeps water cold for hours - so their drink is still refreshing by lunchtime, whether it's in a classroom, a stroller, or the cupholder on a long drive

CUPHOLDER FRIENDLY & DISHWASHER SAFE: Fits most car and stroller cupholders. All Summit straw lids are top-rack dishwasher safe, and bottles are too - one less thing to hand-wash at the end of a long day
SAFE MATERIALS FOR LITTLE HANDS: Food-grade 304 (18/8) stainless steel interior - Our kids tumbler is made without BPA, lead, or phthalates, so it's trusted from toddler cup to classroom water bottle

GIFT-READY FOR TODDLERS & KIDS: A thoughtful pick for birthdays, back-to-school, Easter baskets, and stocking stuffers - most pair with matching Hadley lunchboxes and Fletcher backpacks for a stylish school set. Recommended for toddlers 2 and up
